scope: Frozen retrospective engineering preparation and input audit, no new model, future outcome, scoring or current forecast
authorization: Human user: 来 继续咱们的程序; direct research work is authorized independently of the nightly automation window
source_database: outputs/统一数据底座_20261022/统一数据底座.sqlite
calculation_start_reason: Common engineering start after the unbridged stock 2022-05-26 raw-price discontinuity

index_formula_definitions.past_return_1: C[t]/C[t-1]-1; exact dependency closes t and t-1
index_formula_definitions.past_return_5: C[t]/C[t-5]-1; exact dependency closes t and t-5
index_formula_definitions.past_return_20: C[t]/C[t-20]-1; exact dependency closes t and t-20
index_formula_definitions.close_over_ma20_minus_one: C[t]/mean(C[t-19:t] inclusive)-1; 20 exact dependency closes including current

auxiliary_stock_formula: stock_past_return_5=Cstock[t]/Cstock[t-5]-1, only when both observations are within one known raw-price segment
relative_formula: stock_past_return_5 minus index_past_return_5; signed fraction difference, not a portfolio return, beta-adjusted alpha or causal effect
stock_segment_boundaries: Use saved corporate_actions.ex_date; restart on the ex-date before adding current close; require more than five observations in segment
index_segment_policy: One fixed-provider price-index series from calculation_start, no stock corporate-action resets applied to index
input_date_policy: All eight fixed provider-symbol series must have identical, unique, sorted observed dates; fail rather than silently reindex or fill
information_time: Completed same-date close at or after market close; formula causality on saved snapshots does not certify historical first availability
conflict_policy: Compare exact saved closes across providers. Keep primary-provider diagnostic values but set usable engineering value NULL if any exact formula dependency close is discrepant. No averaging or provider substitution.
transitive_relative_conflict_policy: Relative feature usable only if both the auxiliary stock and index past-5 engineering values are ready; propagate exact dependency close conflicts
non_close_ohlc_conflicts: Report in source audit; do not quarantine a close-only formula for a different unused field
missing_or_not_ready_policy: NULL with explicit reason, never zero; retain every original date
invalid_source_close_policy: Any missing, nonpositive or nonfinite source close rejects the entire preparation batch before feature calculation; ordinary insufficient history remains per-feature NULL
dependency_trace: Every row carries exact symbol/date/primary observation IDs of all closes used; max dependency date <= signal date
index_price_semantics: Price-index changes only, not reinvested total return; 399967 is a military-sector background proxy, historical stock membership unverified
event_default_admission: All current event countdown/lead-time model inputs blocked pending rule-vintage and pre-event publication evidence; dates remain audit data
next_gate: Review independent feature/source/event/industry audits, then separately register one narrow development candidate if warranted; do not open later target periods automatically
